subject: sounds
title: Change one sound
about: Hear a word, swap one sound for another and tap the new word: cat with /h/ at the front is hat, cat with /p/ at the end is cap, hat with /i/ in the middle is hit. Substituting sounds is the top step of NC RF.1.3 phonological awareness (NC lists no separate sub-code for it) and leans on RF.1.3.c, finding the first, middle and last sound.
tip: Say the old word, then the new sound, and let him try the swap out loud before he taps.

cards.q: Change the first sound in cat to /h/. What word do you get?
cards.sayQ: Change the first sound in cat to huh. What word do you get?
cards.note: cat. Take away the first sound and put in huh: hat.

cards.q: Change the first sound in pig to /d/. What word do you get?
cards.sayQ: Change the first sound in pig to duh. What word do you get?
cards.note: pig. Take away the first sound and put in duh: dig.

cards.q: Change the first sound in sun to /f/. What word do you get?
cards.sayQ: Change the first sound in sun to fff. What word do you get?
cards.note: sun. Take away the first sound and put in fff: fun.

cards.q: Change the first sound in bed to /r/. What word do you get?
cards.sayQ: Change the first sound in bed to rrr. What word do you get?
cards.note: bed. Take away the first sound and put in rrr: red.

cards.q: Change the first sound in map to /n/. What word do you get?
cards.sayQ: Change the first sound in map to nnn. What word do you get?
cards.note: map. Take away the first sound and put in nnn: nap.

cards.q: Change the first sound in ship to /ch/. What word do you get?
cards.sayQ: Change the first sound in ship to chuh. What word do you get?
cards.note: ship. Take away the shh and put in chuh: chip. sh and ch are each one sound.

cards.q: Change the last sound in cat to /p/. What word do you get?
cards.sayQ: Change the last sound in cat to puh. What word do you get?
cards.note: cat. Take away the last sound and put in puh: cap.

cards.q: Change the last sound in bus to /n/. What word do you get?
cards.sayQ: Change the last sound in bus to nnn. What word do you get?
cards.note: bus. Take away the last sound and put in nnn: bun.

cards.q: Change the last sound in pin to /g/. What word do you get?
cards.sayQ: Change the last sound in pin to guh. What word do you get?
cards.note: pin. Take away the last sound and put in guh: pig.

cards.q: Change the last sound in hat to /m/. What word do you get?
cards.sayQ: Change the last sound in hat to mmm. What word do you get?
cards.note: hat. Take away the last sound and put in mmm: ham.

cards.q: Change the last sound in mad to /p/. What word do you get?
cards.sayQ: Change the last sound in mad to puh. What word do you get?
cards.note: mad. Take away the last sound and put in puh: map.

cards.q: Change the last sound in cup to /t/. What word do you get?
cards.sayQ: Change the last sound in cup to tuh. What word do you get?
cards.note: cup. Take away the last sound and put in tuh: cut.

cards.q: Change the middle sound in hat to /i/, like in pig. What word do you get?
cards.sayQ: Change the middle sound in hat to ih, like in pig. What word do you get?
cards.note: hat. Keep the h and the t, change the middle to short i: hit.

cards.q: Change the middle sound in bug to /a/, like in hat. What word do you get?
cards.sayQ: Change the middle sound in bug to ah, like in hat. What word do you get?
cards.note: bug. Keep the b and the g, change the middle to short a: bag.

cards.q: Change the middle sound in pat to /e/, like in bed. What word do you get?
cards.sayQ: Change the middle sound in pat to eh, like in bed. What word do you get?
cards.note: pat. Keep the p and the t, change the middle to short e: pet.

cards.q: Change the middle sound in nut to /e/, like in bed. What word do you get?
cards.sayQ: Change the middle sound in nut to eh, like in bed. What word do you get?
cards.note: nut. Keep the n and the t, change the middle to short e: net.

cards.q: Change the middle sound in dig to /u/, like in sun. What word do you get?
cards.sayQ: Change the middle sound in dig to uh, like in sun. What word do you get?
cards.note: dig. Keep the d and the g, change the middle to short u: dug.

cards.q: Change the middle sound in sit to /a/, like in hat. What word do you get?
cards.sayQ: Change the middle sound in sit to ah, like in hat. What word do you get?
cards.note: sit. Keep the s and the t, change the middle to short a: sat.
